ex.s: 배고파요? 그러면 밥 먹으러 가요.
ex.en: You're hungry? Then let's go eat.

ex.s: 오후에 비가 온대요? 그러면 우산 가져갈게요.
ex.en: It's supposed to rain this afternoon? Then I'll take an umbrella.

ex.s: 내일 시간 없어요? 그러면 금요일은 어때요?
ex.en: You're not free tomorrow? Then how about Friday?

ex.s: 휴가 잘 다녀오세요. 다음에 또 봐요!
ex.en: Enjoy your vacation. See you next time!

ex.s: 지우 씨, 오늘 고마웠어요. 다음에 또 봐요.
ex.en: Ji-woo, thanks for today. See you next time.

ex.s: 다음에 또 봐요. 다음엔 제가 살게요.
ex.en: See you next time. Next time it's on me.

ex.s: 제 딸은 머리가 길어서 아침마다 묶어 줘요.
ex.en: My daughter has long hair, so I tie it up for her every morning.

ex.s: 머리가 길어서 여름에는 너무 더워요.
ex.en: My hair is long, so I get really hot in summer.

ex.s: 머리가 긴 분이 저희 선생님이세요.
ex.en: The person with long hair is our teacher.

ex.s: 제 남편은 머리가 짧아서 아침 준비가 빨라요.
ex.en: My husband has short hair, so he gets ready fast in the morning.

ex.s: 머리가 짧으니까 수영할 때 편해요.
ex.en: My hair is short, so swimming is easy.

ex.s: 머리가 짧은 남자분이 우리 팀장님이세요.
ex.en: The man with short hair is our team leader.

ex.s: 이 색깔이 더 좋은 것 같아요.
ex.en: I think this color is better.

ex.s: 새 직장이 좋은 것 같아요.
ex.en: I think my new job is good.

ex.s: 금요일에 만나는 게 좋은 것 같아요.
ex.en: I think meeting on Friday would be good.

ex.s: 큰일 났어요! 여권을 호텔에 두고 왔어요.
ex.en: Oh no! I left my passport at the hotel.

ex.s: 큰일 났어요. 회의가 십 분 후예요!
ex.en: Oh no, the meeting is in ten minutes!

ex.s: 큰일 났어요! 부엌에서 물이 새요.
ex.en: Oh no! Water is leaking in the kitchen.

ex.s: 강남역에서 이 호선으로 갈아타야 돼요.
ex.en: I have to transfer to Line 2 at Gangnam Station.

ex.s: 공항에 가려면 버스를 한 번 갈아타야 돼요.
ex.en: To get to the airport, you have to change buses once.

ex.s: 도쿄에서 비행기를 갈아타야 돼요.
ex.en: I have to change planes in Tokyo.

fix.en: I'm a bit busy right now...

ex.s: 죄송해요, 지금 좀 바쁜데요. 이따가 전화할게요.
ex.en: Sorry, I'm a bit busy right now... I'll call you later.

ex.s: 지금 좀 바쁜데요, 오 분만 기다려 주세요.
ex.en: I'm a bit busy right now... please wait just five minutes.

ex.s: 커피 마시러 갈래요? — 지금 좀 바쁜데요.
ex.en: Want to go get coffee? — I'm a bit busy right now...

ex.s: 차가 막혀서 늦을 것 같아요.
ex.en: Traffic is bad, so I think I'll be late.

ex.s: 미안해요, 십 분쯤 늦을 것 같아요.
ex.en: Sorry, I think I'll be about ten minutes late.

ex.s: 오늘 일이 많아서 퇴근이 늦을 것 같아요.
ex.en: I have a lot of work today, so I think I'll be late getting off work.

notes: Fixed odd 그러면 after own statement; replaced 다음에 또 봐요 said to a teacher (should be 봬요). Rest fine.
